channel.title: Middle East AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Israel/Gaza, Iran, Syria, Lebanon and Iraq developments

item.title: IDF targets Yahya Sinwar's successor, Hamas Gaza leader Ali al-Amoudi, in strike
item.description: IDF attack helicopters and tanks struck targets in Gaza on Saturday in an operation aimed at killing Ali al-Amoudi, who succeeded Yahya Sinwar as Hamas's leader in the Gaza Strip.

item.title: Flydubai co-pilot was banned from flying in Oman after showing 'radical ideological views' - report
item.description: The report follows comments by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu after the attempted hijacking, saying that the hijacker underwent radical Islamist indoctrination and was clearly suicidal.

item.title: 'Attempted terror attack': UAE prosecution reveals first details of flydubai investigation
item.description: The co-pilot attacked the pilot inside the cockpit with an axe and attempted to take control of the aircraft, the prosecutor general said.

item.title: First Arkia repatriation flight lands in Israel after returning from Dubai
item.description: The first repatriation flight landed in Dubai to return stranded Israelis after the first rescue flight's landing permission was revoked by UAE authorities.

item.title: US-led initiative tightens efforts to block weapons from reaching Iran, stop nuclear proliferation
item.description: The US and its partners said they would strengthen intelligence sharing to prevent Iran from acquiring or transferring technology linked to the development of weapons of mass destruction.

item.title: Who will teach the next generation?
item.description: A Jerusalem summit will bring together more than 300 educators from Israel and around the world to share ideas, confront common challenges, and strengthen the connections that sustain Jewish life.

item.title: No. 1: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump: Remembering who brought the hostages home
item.description: Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump helped achieve what few in Jerusalem thought possible, bringing every Israeli hostage home and reshaping the Middle East.

item.title: No. 3: Gadi Eisenkot: Israel’s next prime minister?
item.description: The former IDF chief has emerged as the leading opposition challenger to Netanyahu, offering voters a path to a post-Netanyahu Israel.

item.title: No. 4: Naftali Bennett: The former PM seeking a comeback to ‘repair Israel’
item.description: Since returning to politics, Bennett has shifted from his previous campaigns, taking a more liberal position while maintaining a strong right-wing stance on security.

item.title: No. 5: Ronald Lauder: Standing at the forefront of the fight against antisemitism
item.description: Lauder has never confined himself to quiet philanthropy - he continues to use his position to demand accountability from political leaders.

item.title: No. 2: Benjamin Netanyahu: Shaping Israel’s politics and global image for a generation
item.description: Netanyahu has become more than Israel’s prime minister for many. Abroad, for instance, he has become Israel’s symbol and the lightning rod for much of the hatred directed against the Jewish state.

item.title: UAE source criticizes Israel's use of 'rescue flights' after flydubai incident
item.description: A UAE source criticized Israel's description of flights from the Emirates as 'rescue flights,' saying the UAE agreed to additional security measures, but Israel rejected revised flydubai procedures.

item.title: Israeli filmmakers launch counter-documentary to rebut ‘NAZA’
item.description: The counter-project, titled NAZA: The Real Story, dropped with English subtitles this week in a bid to immediately intercept the global narrative.

item.title: Israeli man used AI, ChatGPT in covert tasks while spying for Iran, prosecution indictment reveals
item.description: Prosecutors say the 25-year-old from Baka al-Gharbiya carried out missions for an Iranian handler, received cryptocurrency payments, used AI tools, and shared details about his workplace security.

item.title: Ten years later: How an Israeli surgeon saved three lives in on Yom Kippur - opinion
item.description: Would any Israeli doctor ever give up the privilege of helping to secure a place for a patient in the Book of Life on Yom Kippur?

item.title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel, will it curb prices?
item.description: Global energy prices have soared due to the US and Israel's war on Iran and Russia's war on Ukraine.

item.title: Israeli air attack on residential apartment in Gaza kills 5 Palestinians
item.description: An Israeli air attack on a residential apartment in Gaza City has killed at least five Palestinians.

item.title: Gaza voters want jobs and security as Palestinian elections approach
item.description: Ahead of first Palestinian national elections in 20 years, people in Gaza hope to rebuild after Israeli destruction.

item.title: New claims that Netanyahu rejected Hamas offer to release captives
item.description: Reports are building that Israel rejected a Hamas offer to release all civilian hostages taken on October 7, 2023.

item.title: WHO warns of ‘devastating consequences’ due to delayed aid entry into Gaza
item.description: The WHO's representative in Palestine calls on Israeli authorities to 'release the pressure on medical supplies'.
